source: NVDA Alpaca SIP split-adjusted regular 15m, official calendar and verified Phase 41G v2 source bridge
sourceAvailability: Historical simulated close plus 20 minutes; never an original provider receipt timestamp
secondaryPopulations: Other SMA periods and BULLISH, 1h and 1d separately; no pooled horizon
visits: Reuse Phase 41G v2 event IDs, regime IDs, episode numbers, censoring and eligibility without redefining them
geometricContact: The event candle is complete and verified, its final SMA is finite, and low <= SMA <= high
nonintersection: A valid Phase 41G visit whose event candle range does not contain its final SMA

rejection.bearish: geometric contact and close < final SMA and Phase 41A REJECTED_BELOW at candle close
rejection.bullish: geometric contact and close > final SMA and Phase 41A REJECTED_ABOVE at candle close
rejection.disagreement: Audit any incompatible or absent Phase 41A rejection separately; do not change Phase 41A

decisionTime: Event candle close plus the verified 20-minute simulated SIP availability, never intrabar touch time
outcomes: Join Phase 41G v2 visit-outcomes by eventId without recalculating labels or excursions
entry: First scheduled candle opening strictly after assumedAvailableAtUtc as defined by Phase 41G

comparisons.A: first observed visit with rejection versus first observed visit without rejection
comparisons.B: later observed visit with rejection versus later observed visit without rejection
comparisons.C: first observed visit with rejection versus later observed visit with rejection
comparisons.D: all observed visits with rejection versus actual geometric contacts without rejection
comparisons.E: rejections versus all Phase 41G observed visits of same frame, direction and SMA; overlapping reference

comparisonEligibility: Exclude left-censored visits; use only evaluable outcomes on the same frame, direction, SMA and horizon
primaryMetrics: terminal favorable/adverse/neutral rates at four bars

uncertainty.method: 1000 seeded resamples of complete session or complete regime clusters, keeping all simultaneous events in each selected cluster; descriptive sensitivity, not independent validation
uncertainty.insufficientEvidence: fewer than 30 evaluable events or 30 distinct sessions in either compared group
uncertainty.crossedClusters: Session and regime groupings overlap, so neither alone captures all temporal dependencies; suppress interval when coherent pairing cannot be maintained
uncertainty.multipleComparisons: Numerous subgroup intervals are descriptive, not separate confirmed hypotheses

leftCensoring: Keep in coverage and transition audit but exclude from primary A-E comparisons
rightCensoring: Keep unavailable outcomes with original Phase 41G reason; never impute
interpretation: Historical descriptive association only, not profitability or predictive validation
